In the observation paper, close numerical approximations to successive states, usually from higher bits QCG look aX²+c. The common linear term is mentioned with reference to another work (p. 1472). Theorem 5 unknown a,c uses four consecutive approximations and exceptional sets; O(Δ¹⁹) non-informative Δ¹⁹>=p (page) 1484). This is not a universal practical threshold QCG §5.2 not carried out; special investigations were conducted Pollard-Chance.

Our validation does not replicate these algorithms: our own common invariant takes into account a,b,c and the minor unequal masks, its output and checkable barriers are given in MATH.md and PROTOCOL.md.
